subject: Operations
title: Inventory Costs
description: Learn Inventory Costs in one minute.

hook.text: Holding one pallet of goods for a year can cost 25% of its value. Inventory is a silent cash drain.

buildup.text: Inventory costs include holding, ordering, shortage, and the opportunity cost of tied-up capital.

discovery.text: Holding costs cover storage, insurance, damage, obsolescence, and interest on locked-up cash.

twist.text: Ordering too often raises transaction costs. Ordering too little raises holding costs. There's a sweet spot.

climax.text: The tradeoff between ordering and holding costs is the foundation of every inventory model ever built.

punchline.text: Every box sitting still is money standing still.

quiz.question: What can holding inventory cost per year as a percentage of value?
